title: The Living Christ: The Testimony of the Apostles
meta_description: Official testimony by the First Presidency and the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, bearing witness of the reality, divinity, and mission of Jesus Christ. Issued January 1, 2000, to commemorate the two-thousandth anniversary of His birth.
study_intro: On January 1, 2000, the First Presidency and the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles issued 'The Living Christ: The Testimony of the Apostles' to commemorate the two-thousandth anniversary of the birth of Jesus Christ. This document testifies of His premortal divinity, mortal ministry, atoning sacrifice, resurrection, latter-day appearances, and future return. It is widely displayed in Church meetinghouses and homes, and frequently cited in general conference.
authors: The Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
event: Commemoration of the two-thousandth anniversary of the birth of Jesus Christ
